meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Setup-Conflict-Resolution 叙事框架，把原始数据整理成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，给出结论与下一步行动建议。
howto.when: 当你需要向高管汇报、制作季度业务回顾或投资者演示，并把数据讲给非技术受众听时，它会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这份流失数据整理成给高管看的叙事报告
用问题-解决的故事框架改写这份季度业绩回顾
say.note: 按钩子、上下文、洞察、建议组织

say.text: 把这些图表串成一个有叙事线的演示稿
say.note: 加入渐进揭示和标注高亮

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative framework to turn raw data into insight reports that combine visuals with business context, ending in a conclusion and next-step recommendations.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you need to present data to executives, build a quarterly business review or investor deck, and explain the numbers to a non-technical audience.

say_en.text: Turn this churn data into a narrative report for executives
Rewrite this quarterly review with a problem-solution story
say_en.note: Structured as hook, context, insight, recommendation

say_en.text: String these charts into a deck with a narrative arc
say_en.note: Adds progressive reveal and annotation highlights
